# roxyapi: Complete Method Reference

> Dart and Flutter SDK for RoxyAPI. Multi-domain spiritual and metaphysical intelligence API. Fully typed. Install: `dart pub add roxyapi`

Every method returns its typed response and throws `RoxyException` on an error response. Parameters are named: path, body and query values in one list, then `lang`.

```dart
import 'package:roxyapi/roxyapi.dart';

final roxy = Roxy(Platform.environment['ROXY_API_KEY'] ?? '');
```

<!-- BEGIN:LANGS -->
**Multi-language responses.** Interpretations and editorial text are available in 10 languages: `en`, `tr`, `de`, `es`, `hi`, `pt`, `fr`, `ru`, `zh-Hans`, `zh-Hant`. Pass a `Lang` value as `lang` on a supported method. Supported: `astrology`, `vedicAstrology`, `forecast`, `humanDesign`, `chineseAstrology`, `fengShui`, `mesoamericanAstrology`, `vastu`, `numerology`, `kabbalah`, `tarot`, `biorhythm`, `ayurveda`, `iching`, `crystals`, `angelNumbers`, `reports`, `languages`. English-only: `dreams`, `location`, `usage`. A field without a translation in the requested language returns English.
<!-- END:LANGS -->

<!-- BEGIN:METHODS -->
## Western Astrology: `roxy.astrology`

Western astrology API for natal birth charts, daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly horoscopes with unique content per s...

[API reference](https://roxyapi.com/api-reference/western-astrology)

```dart
// Get all zodiac signs - Complete zodiac signs list with dates and elements
final result = await roxy.astrology.listZodiacSigns();
// Returns List<ListZodiacSignsResponseItem>: id String, name String, symbol String?, element String, elementLocalized String?, dates ListZodiacSignsResponseItemDates, description String

// Get zodiac sign details - Complete astrology sign profile with personality traits
final result = await roxy.astrology.getZodiacSign(id: 'aries');
// Returns GetZodiacSignResponse: id String, name String, symbol String?, symbolName String, element String, elementLocalized String?, modality String, modalityLocalized String?, rulingPlanet String, rulingPlanetLocalized String?, dates GetZodiacSignResponseDates, keywords List<String>, description GetZodiacSignResponseDescription, famous List<String>?, strengths List<String>?, motto String?, gifts String?, challenges String?, weapon String?, compatibleSigns List<String>

// Get all planet meanings - Complete astrology planet interpretations list
final result = await roxy.astrology.listPlanetMeanings();
// Returns List<ListPlanetMeaningsResponseItem>: id String, name String, symbol String, tagline String, category String?, rulership String?, description String

// Get planet meaning details - Complete astrology planet interpretation
final result = await roxy.astrology.getPlanetMeaning(id: 'sun');
// Returns GetPlanetMeaningResponse: id String, name String, symbol String, tagline String, category String?, temperature String, orbit String, retrograde bool?, rulership String?, detriment String?, exaltation String?, exultation String?, fall String?, keywords GetPlanetMeaningResponseKeywords, description GetPlanetMeaningResponseDescription

// Generate natal chart - Birth chart calculator API with houses and aspects
final result = await roxy.astrology.generateNatalChart(date: '1990-07-15', time: '14:30:00', latitude: 40.7128, longitude: -74.006, timezone: NumOrString.string('America/New_York'), nodeType: NodeType.true$, houseSystem: HouseSystem.placidus);
// Returns NatalChartResponse: birthDetails NatalChartResponseBirthDetails, planets List<NatalChartResponsePlanetsItem>, houses List<NatalChartResponseHousesItem>, houseSystem String, aspects List<NatalChartResponseAspectsItem>, patterns List<NatalChartResponsePatternsItem>?, aspectsInterpretation NatalChartResponseAspectsInterpretation, ascendant NatalChartResponseAscendant, midheaven NatalChartResponseMidheaven, partOfFortune NatalChartResponsePartOfFortune, vertex NatalChartResponseVertex, summary NatalChartResponseSummary

// Get planetary positions - Ephemeris calculator for all planets
final result = await roxy.astrology.getPlanetaryPositions(date: '2025-12-18', time: '12:00:00', nodeType: NodeType.true$, latitude: 40.7128, longitude: -74.006, timezone: NumOrString.string('America/New_York'));
// Returns GetPlanetaryPositionsResponse: planets List<GetPlanetaryPositionsResponsePlanetsItem>

// Monthly Ephemeris - Daily tropical planetary positions for a month
final result = await roxy.astrology.getMonthlyTropicalEphemeris(year: 2026, month: 8);
// Returns GetMonthlyTropicalEphemerisResponse: year num, month num, days List<GetMonthlyTropicalEphemerisResponseDaysItem>

// Get current moon phase - Lunar phase calculator with zodiac sign
final result = await roxy.astrology.getCurrentMoonPhase(date: '2025-12-18', time: '12:00:00', timezone: 'America/New_York');
// Returns GetCurrentMoonPhaseResponse: date String, phase String, illumination num, age num, sign String, degree num, distance num, meaning GetCurrentMoonPhaseResponseMeaning?

// Get upcoming moon phases - Next new moon, full moon, quarters
final result = await roxy.astrology.getUpcomingMoonPhases(startDate: '2025-12-18', count: 8);
// Returns GetUpcomingMoonPhasesResponse: phases List<GetUpcomingMoonPhasesResponsePhasesItem>

// Get lunar calendar - Moon phases for entire month
final result = await roxy.astrology.getMoonCalendar(year: 2026, month: 3);
// Returns GetMoonCalendarResponse: year num, month num, monthName String, calendar List<GetMoonCalendarResponseCalendarItem>

// Calculate synastry - Relationship compatibility analysis API
final result = await roxy.astrology.calculateSynastry(person1: CalculateSynastryRequestPerson1(date: '1990-07-15', time: '14:30:00', latitude: 40.7128, longitude: -74.006, timezone: NumOrString.string('America/New_York'), nodeType: NodeType.true$, name: 'Alex'), person2: CalculateSynastryRequestPerson2(date: '1990-07-15', time: '14:30:00', latitude: 40.7128, longitude: -74.006, timezone: NumOrString.string('America/New_York'), nodeType: NodeType.true$, name: 'Alex'), houseSystem: HouseSystem.placidus);
// Returns CalculateSynastryResponse: person1 CalculateSynastryResponsePerson1, person2 CalculateSynastryResponsePerson2, compatibilityScore num, interAspects List<CalculateSynastryResponseInterAspectsItem>, summary CalculateSynastryResponseSummary, analysis CalculateSynastryResponseAnalysis

// Calculate house cusps - House system calculator with comparison
final result = await roxy.astrology.calculateHouses(date: '1990-07-15', time: '14:30:00', latitude: 40.7128, longitude: -74.006, timezone: NumOrString.string('America/New_York'), houseSystem: HouseSystem.placidus);
// Returns HousesResponse: date String, time String, latitude num, longitude num, timezone num, houseSystem String, ascendant HousesResponseAscendant, midheaven HousesResponseMidheaven, houses List<HousesResponseHousesItem>, comparison Map<String, HousesResponseComparisonValue>?

// Calculate planetary aspects - Aspect finder for any date and time
final result = await roxy.astrology.calculateAspects(date: '1990-07-15', time: '14:30:00', timezone: NumOrString.string('America/New_York'), planets: ['Sun', 'Moon', 'Mercury', 'Venus', 'Mars'], aspectTypes: ['CONJUNCTION', 'OPPOSITION', 'TRINE', 'SQUARE']);
// Returns AspectsResponse: date String, time String, timezone num, aspectsFound num, aspects List<AspectsResponseAspectsItem>, patterns List<AspectsResponsePatternsItem>?, summary AspectsResponseSummary

// Monthly Aspects - Tropical aspect calendar for an entire month
final result = await roxy.astrology.getMonthlyTropicalAspects(year: 2026, month: 3, timezone: NumOrString.string('America/New_York'), nodeType: NodeType.true$);
// Returns GetMonthlyTropicalAspectsResponse: year num, month num, timezone num, events List<GetMonthlyTropicalAspectsResponseEventsItem>

// Detect aspect patterns - Grand Trine, Kite, T-Square, Grand Cross, Yod, Mystic Rectangle, Stellium
final result = await roxy.astrology.detectAspectPatterns(date: '1990-07-15', time: '14:30:00', latitude: 40.7128, longitude: -74.006, timezone: NumOrString.string('America/New_York'), nodeType: NodeType.true$, strictOrbs: 'false', include: '');
// Returns AspectPatternsResponse: patterns List<AspectPatternsResponsePatternsItem>, total num, options AspectPatternsResponseOptions

// Calculate planetary transits - Current transits with natal chart comparison
final result = await roxy.astrology.calculateTransits(date: '2025-12-19', time: '12:00:00', timezone: NumOrString.number(0), nodeType: NodeType.true$);
// Returns TransitsResponse: transitDate String, transitTime String, timezone num, transitPlanets List<TransitsResponseTransitPlanetsItem>, transitAspects List<TransitsResponseTransitAspectsItem>?, summary TransitsResponseSummary?

// Monthly Transits - Tropical sign ingresses for an entire month
final result = await roxy.astrology.getMonthlyTropicalTransits(year: 2026, month: 3, timezone: NumOrString.string('America/New_York'), nodeType: NodeType.true$);
// Returns GetMonthlyTropicalTransitsResponse: year num, month num, timezone num, startingPositions List<GetMonthlyTropicalTransitsResponseStartingPositionsItem>, transitEvents List<GetMonthlyTropicalTransitsResponseTransitEventsItem>

// Transit Aspects - Detailed transit-to-natal aspect analysis with interpretations
final result = await roxy.astrology.calculateTransitAspects(natalChart: CalculateTransitAspectsRequestNatalChart(date: '1990-07-15', time: '14:30:00', latitude: 40.7128, longitude: -74.006, timezone: NumOrString.string('America/New_York'), nodeType: NodeType.true$), transitDate: '2026-02-03', transitTime: '12:00:00', planets: [Planets.jupiter, Planets.saturn, Planets.pluto], aspectTypes: [AspectTypes.conjunction, AspectTypes.opposition, AspectTypes.trine, AspectTypes.square], minStrength: 50, houseSystem: HouseSystem.placidus);
// Returns CalculateTransitAspectsResponse: transitDate String, houseSystem String, houses List<CalculateTransitAspectsResponseHousesItem>, ascendant CalculateTransitAspectsResponseAscendant, transitPlanets List<CalculateTransitAspectsResponseTransitPlanetsItem>, natalPlanets List<CalculateTransitAspectsResponseNatalPlanetsItem>, aspects List<CalculateTransitAspectsResponseAspectsItem>, summary CalculateTransitAspectsResponseSummary

// Monthly Parallels - Declination contacts for an entire month
final result = await roxy.astrology.getMonthlyDeclinationParallels(year: 2026, month: 3, timezone: NumOrString.string('America/New_York'), orb: 1.5, nodeType: NodeType.true$);
// Returns GetMonthlyDeclinationParallelsResponse: year num, month num, timezone num, orb num, events List<GetMonthlyDeclinationParallelsResponseEventsItem>

// Ecliptic Crossings - Node passages for a whole year
final result = await roxy.astrology.getPlanetaryNodePassages(year: 2026, timezone: NumOrString.string('America/New_York'));
// Returns GetPlanetaryNodePassagesResponse: year num, timezone num, events List<GetPlanetaryNodePassagesResponseEventsItem>

// Solar Return Chart - Annual birthday forecast with relocated chart
final result = await roxy.astrology.generateSolarReturn(birthDate: '1990-07-15', birthTime: '14:30:00', returnYear: 2026, latitude: 40.7128, longitude: -74.006, timezone: NumOrString.string('America/New_York'), houseSystem: HouseSystem.placidus);
// Returns GenerateSolarReturnResponse: birthDate String, solarReturnDate String, solarReturnYear num, location GenerateSolarReturnResponseLocation, chart GenerateSolarReturnResponseChart, natalSunPosition GenerateSolarReturnResponseNatalSunPosition, interpretation GenerateSolarReturnResponseInterpretation

// Lunar Return Chart - Monthly emotional forecast with Moon cycle chart
final result = await roxy.astrology.generateLunarReturn(birthDate: '1990-07-15', birthTime: '14:30:00', returnDate: '2026-02-12', latitude: 40.7128, longitude: -74.006, timezone: NumOrString.string('America/New_York'), houseSystem: HouseSystem.placidus);
// Returns GenerateLunarReturnResponse: birthDate String, lunarReturnDate String, location GenerateLunarReturnResponseLocation, chart GenerateLunarReturnResponseChart, natalMoonPosition GenerateLunarReturnResponseNatalMoonPosition, interpretation GenerateLunarReturnResponseInterpretation

// Composite Chart - Midpoint relationship chart with interpretations
final result = await roxy.astrology.generateCompositeChart(person1: GenerateCompositeChartRequestPerson1(date: '1990-07-15', time: '14:30:00', latitude: 40.7128, longitude: -74.006, timezone: NumOrString.string('America/New_York'), nodeType: NodeType.true$), person2: GenerateCompositeChartRequestPerson2(date: '1990-07-15', time: '14:30:00', latitude: 40.7128, longitude: -74.006, timezone: NumOrString.string('America/New_York'), nodeType: NodeType.true$), houseSystem: HouseSystem.placidus);
// Returns GenerateCompositeChartResponse: person1 GenerateCompositeChartResponsePerson1, person2 GenerateCompositeChartResponsePerson2, compositePlanets List<GenerateCompositeChartResponseCompositePlanetsItem>, compositeHouses List<GenerateCompositeChartResponseCompositeHousesItem>, compositeAscendant GenerateCompositeChartResponseCompositeAscendant, compositeMidheaven GenerateCompositeChartResponseCompositeMidheaven, aspects List<GenerateCompositeChartResponseAspectsItem>, interpretation GenerateCompositeChartResponseInterpretation

// Compatibility score - Relationship compatibility API
final result = await roxy.astrology.calculateCompatibility(person1: CalculateCompatibilityRequestPerson1(date: '1990-07-15', time: '14:30:00', latitude: 40.7128, longitude: -74.006, timezone: NumOrString.string('America/New_York'), nodeType: NodeType.true$), person2: CalculateCompatibilityRequestPerson2(date: '1990-07-15', time: '14:30:00', latitude: 40.7128, longitude: -74.006, timezone: NumOrString.string('America/New_York'), nodeType: NodeType.true$));
// Returns CalculateCompatibilityResponse: overallScore num, categories CalculateCompatibilityResponseCategories, persons CalculateCompatibilityResponsePersons, signCompatibility CalculateCompatibilityResponseSignCompatibility, elementBalance CalculateCompatibilityResponseElementBalance, archetype CalculateCompatibilityResponseArchetype, strengths List<String>, challenges List<String>, summary String, interpretation String, aspectBreakdown CalculateCompatibilityResponseAspectBreakdown, keyAspects List<CalculateCompatibilityResponseKeyAspectsItem>

// Daily horoscope by zodiac sign - Transit-based editorial columns
final result = await roxy.astrology.getDailyHoroscope(sign: Sign.aries, date: '2026-04-03', timezone: 'America/New_York');
// Returns GetDailyHoroscopeResponse: sign String, date String, overview String, love String, career String, health String, finance String, advice String, column String, events List<GetDailyHoroscopeResponseEventsItem>, luckyNumber num, luckyColor String, compatibleSigns List<String>, activeTransits List<String>, moonSign String, moonPhase String, energyRating num

// Weekly horoscope by zodiac sign - Seven-day editorial column
final result = await roxy.astrology.getWeeklyHoroscope(sign: Sign.aries, date: '2026-04-03', timezone: 'America/New_York');
// Returns GetWeeklyHoroscopeResponse: sign String, week String, overview String, love String, career String, health String, finance String, advice String, column String, events List<GetWeeklyHoroscopeResponseEventsItem>, luckyDays List<String>, luckyNumbers List<num>, compatibleSigns List<String>

// Monthly horoscope by zodiac sign - Editorial column with key dates
final result = await roxy.astrology.getMonthlyHoroscope(sign: Sign.aries, date: '2026-04-03', timezone: 'America/New_York');
// Returns GetMonthlyHoroscopeResponse: sign String, month String, overview String, love String, career String, health String, finance String, advice String, column String, events List<GetMonthlyHoroscopeResponseEventsItem>, weekByWeek List<GetMonthlyHoroscopeResponseWeekByWeekItem>, keyDates List<GetMonthlyHoroscopeResponseKeyDatesItem>, luckyNumbers List<num>, luckyColor String, compatibleSigns List<String>

// Yearly horoscope by zodiac sign - Year ahead forecast with themes, key periods, eclipses and retrogrades
final result = await roxy.astrology.getYearlyHoroscope(sign: Sign.aries, year: 2026, timezone: 'America/New_York');
// Returns GetYearlyHoroscopeResponse: sign String, year int, overview String, love String, career String, health String, finance String, advice String, column String, events List<GetYearlyHoroscopeResponseEventsItem>, themes List<GetYearlyHoroscopeResponseThemesItem>, eclipses List<GetYearlyHoroscopeResponseEclipsesItem>, retrogrades List<GetYearlyHoroscopeResponseRetrogradesItem>, keyPeriods List<GetYearlyHoroscopeResponseKeyPeriodsItem>, bestPeriods GetYearlyHoroscopeResponseBestPeriods, luckyNumbers List<num>, luckyColor String, compatibleSigns List<String>

// Planetary Return Chart - Saturn return, Jupiter return, and inner planet cycles
final result = await roxy.astrology.generatePlanetaryReturn(birthDate: '1990-07-15', birthTime: '14:30:00', planet: Planet.jupiter, approximateDate: '2026-08-15', latitude: 40.7128, longitude: -74.006, timezone: NumOrString.string('America/New_York'), houseSystem: HouseSystem.placidus);
// Returns GeneratePlanetaryReturnResponse: birthDate String, planet String, returnDate String, approximateCycle String, location GeneratePlanetaryReturnResponseLocation, chart GeneratePlanetaryReturnResponseChart, natalPlanetPosition GeneratePlanetaryReturnResponseNatalPlanetPosition, interpretation GeneratePlanetaryReturnResponseInterpretation

// Astrocartography map - planetary lines and relocation calculator
final result = await roxy.astrology.generateAstrocartography(date: '1990-07-15', time: '14:30:00', latitude: 40.7128, longitude: -74.006, timezone: NumOrString.string('America/New_York'), nodeType: NodeType.true$, include: 'chiron');
// Returns AstrocartographyResponse: birthDetails AstrocartographyResponseBirthDetails, lines List<AstrocartographyResponseLinesItem>, summary String

// Generate relocation chart - Relocated birth chart calculator with shifted houses and angles

// Returns RelocationChartResponse: birthDetails RelocationChartResponseBirthDetails, relocation RelocationChartResponseRelocation, planets List<RelocationPlanet>, houses List<RelocationChartResponseHousesItem>, houseSystem String, ascendant RelocationChartResponseAscendant, midheaven RelocationChartResponseMidheaven, vertex RelocationChartResponseVertex, changes RelocationChartResponseChanges, interpretation RelocationChartResponseInterpretation

// Fixed stars and star conjunctions calculator - Regulus, Spica, Algol natal report
final result = await roxy.astrology.generateFixedStars(date: '1990-07-15', time: '14:30:00', latitude: 40.7128, longitude: -74.006, timezone: NumOrString.string('America/New_York'), nodeType: NodeType.true$, orb: 1);
// Returns FixedStarsResponse: birthDetails FixedStarsResponseBirthDetails, orb num, stars List<FixedStarsResponseStarsItem>, conjunctions List<FixedStarsResponseConjunctionsItem>, summary String

// Arabic lots calculator - seven Hermetic parts including Part of Fortune and Spirit
final result = await roxy.astrology.calculateArabicLots(date: '1990-07-15', time: '14:30:00', latitude: 40.7128, longitude: -74.006, timezone: NumOrString.string('America/New_York'), nodeType: NodeType.true$, houseSystem: HouseSystem.placidus);
// Returns ArabicLotsResponse: birthDetails ArabicLotsResponseBirthDetails, sect String, lots List<ArabicLotsResponseLotsItem>, summary String

// Returns LilithResponse: birthDetails LilithResponseBirthDetails, houseSystem String, lilith List<LilithResponseLilithItem>, summary String

// Returns ProfectionsResponse: birthDetails ProfectionsResponseBirthDetails, targetDate String, age int, profectedHouse int, profectedSign String, lordOfYear String, lordNatalPosition ProfectionsResponseLordNatalPosition, interpretation String, summary String
```

## Vedic Astrology: `roxy.vedicAstrology`

Vedic astrology (Jyotish) and KP API for kundli generation with the sixteen Shodasavarga divisional charts (D1 to D60...

[API reference](https://roxyapi.com/api-reference/vedic-astrology)

```dart
// Get birth chart (D1 Rashi chart) - Kundli Calculator API
final result = await roxy.vedicAstrology.generateBirthChart(date: '1990-07-04', time: '10:12:00', latitude: 28.6139, longitude: 77.209, timezone: NumOrString.number(5.5), ayanamsa: Ayanamsa.lahiri, ayanamsaValue: 24, avasthaInfo: true, modernPlanets: true, focus: Focus.general);
// Returns BirthChartResponse: aries BirthChartResponseAries, taurus BirthChartResponseTaurus, gemini BirthChartResponseGemini, cancer BirthChartResponseCancer, leo BirthChartResponseLeo, virgo BirthChartResponseVirgo, libra BirthChartResponseLibra, scorpio BirthChartResponseScorpio, sagittarius BirthChartResponseSagittarius, capricorn BirthChartResponseCapricorn, aquarius BirthChartResponseAquarius, pisces BirthChartResponsePisces, frame BirthChartResponseFrame, modernPlanets List<BirthChartResponseModernPlanetsItem>?, houses List<BirthChartResponseHousesItem>, combustion List<BirthChartResponseCombustionItem>, planetaryWar List<BirthChartResponsePlanetaryWarItem>, interpretations Map<String, BirthChartResponseInterpretationsValue>, yogas List<BirthChartResponseYogasItem>?, meta Map<String, BirthChartResponseMetaValue>

// Get Navamsa chart (D9) - Marriage Compatibility Calculator
final result = await roxy.vedicAstrology.generateNavamsa(date: '1990-07-04', time: '10:12:00', latitude: 28.6139, longitude: 77.209, timezone: NumOrString.number(5.5), ayanamsa: Ayanamsa.lahiri, ayanamsaValue: 24);
// Returns NavamsaResponse: chart NavamsaResponseChart, frame NavamsaResponseFrame, vargottama List<String>, vargottamaExplanation String

// Get divisional chart (Varga) - D2 to D60 Calculator
final result = await roxy.vedicAstrology.generateDivisionalChart(date: '1990-07-04', time: '10:12:00', latitude: 28.6139, longitude: 77.209, timezone: NumOrString.number(5.5), ayanamsa: Ayanamsa.lahiri, ayanamsaValue: 24, division: 10);
// Returns DivisionalChartResponse: division DivisionalChartResponseDivision, frame DivisionalChartResponseFrame, chart DivisionalChartResponseChart, vargottama List<String>

// Calculate compatibility score - Gun Milan API (Ashtakoot Matching)
final result = await roxy.vedicAstrology.calculateGunMilan(person1: CompatibilityRequestPerson1(date: '1990-07-04', time: '10:12:00', latitude: 28.6139, longitude: 77.209, timezone: NumOrString.number(5.5)), person2: CompatibilityRequestPerson2(date: '1990-07-04', time: '10:12:00', latitude: 28.6139, longitude: 77.209, timezone: NumOrString.number(5.5)), ayanamsa: Ayanamsa.lahiri, ayanamsaValue: 24);
// Returns CompatibilityResponse: frame CompatibilityResponseFrame, total num, maxScore num, percentage num, isCompatible bool, recommendation String, doshas List<String>, doshaCancellations List<CompatibilityResponseDoshaCancellationsItem>, breakdown List<CompatibilityResponseBreakdownItem>

// Calculate ten porutham match - Dashakoot South Indian Kundli Matching API
final result = await roxy.vedicAstrology.calculateDashakoot(person1: DashakootRequestPerson1(date: '1990-07-04', time: '10:12:00', latitude: 28.6139, longitude: 77.209, timezone: NumOrString.number(5.5)), person2: DashakootRequestPerson2(date: '1990-07-04', time: '10:12:00', latitude: 28.6139, longitude: 77.209, timezone: NumOrString.number(5.5)), ayanamsa: Ayanamsa.lahiri, ayanamsaValue: 24);
// Returns DashakootResponse: frame DashakootResponseFrame, total num, maxTotal num, verdict String, recommendation String, rajju DashakootResponseRajju, vedha DashakootResponseVedha, breakdown List<DashakootResponseBreakdownItem>

// Compare malefic affliction - Papasamyam Kundli Matching API
final result = await roxy.vedicAstrology.calculatePapasamyam(person1: PapasamyamRequestPerson1(date: '1990-07-04', time: '10:12:00', latitude: 28.6139, longitude: 77.209, timezone: NumOrString.number(5.5)), person2: PapasamyamRequestPerson2(date: '1990-07-04', time: '10:12:00', latitude: 28.6139, longitude: 77.209, timezone: NumOrString.number(5.5)), ayanamsa: Ayanamsa.lahiri, ayanamsaValue: 24);
// Returns PapasamyamResponse: frame PapasamyamResponseFrame, person1 PapasamyamResponsePerson1, person2 PapasamyamResponsePerson2, verdict String, recommendation String

// Get planetary positions - Graha Positions API
final result = await roxy.vedicAstrology.getPlanetPositions(date: '1990-07-04', time: '10:12:00', latitude: 28.6139, longitude: 77.209, timezone: NumOrString.number(5.5), ayanamsa: Ayanamsa.lahiri, ayanamsaValue: 24);
// Returns PlanetaryPositionsResponse: 

// Monthly Ephemeris - Daily sidereal planetary positions for a month
final result = await roxy.vedicAstrology.getMonthlyEphemeris(year: 2026, month: 2, coordinateSystem: CoordinateSystem.sidereal);
// Returns GetMonthlyEphemerisResponse: year num, month num, days List<GetMonthlyEphemerisResponseDaysItem>
```

<!-- END:METHODS -->

## Error Handling

<!-- BEGIN:ERRORS -->
Every error returns `{ error, code, doc_url }`, thrown as `RoxyException` with `statusCode`, `code`, `message` and `docUrl`. Switch on `code`; `message` is readable text and may change. Each meaning below says whether and when to retry, and `retryAfter` carries the wait when the response sends it. Every code is documented at https://roxyapi.com/docs/errors.

| Status | Code | Meaning |
|--------|------|---------|
| 400 | `validation_error` | A field is missing or invalid. The body lists every failing field at once in issues, each with its path and the expected shape. |
| 400 | `bad_request` | The request was rejected as a whole, for example a body that is not valid JSON or a date range that ends before it starts. |
| 400 | `date_out_of_range` | A date lies outside the span the planetary positions are served for. The error names the supported dates. |
| 400 | `invalid_branding` | The report branding cannot be used, for example a logo that is not a PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG image. |
| 400 | `logo_fetch_failed` | The report logo could not be fetched: it must be an HTTPS URL on a public host that answers within the size limit. |
| 400 | `unsupported_character` | The report text holds a character no report font draws. The error names it: remove or replace it. |
| 401 | `api_key_required` | No API key was sent. |
| 401 | `invalid_api_key` | The key sent is malformed or cannot be verified. |
| 401 | `api_key_revoked` | The key was valid once and has since been revoked from the account page. |
| 401 | `subscription_not_found` | The key verifies, but the subscription behind it no longer exists. |
| 401 | `subscription_inactive` | The subscription behind the key is cancelled, expired or suspended, or a trial is past its end date. |
| 401 | `publishable_key_not_allowed_on_mcp` | A publishable key was used on a Remote MCP server, which takes a secret key. |
| 401 | `invalid_client_ip` | A keyless request could not be attributed to a caller. |
| 401 | `unauthorized` | Authentication failed with no more specific reason to give. |
| 403 | `forbidden` | The key is valid, but this request is not permitted. |
| 403 | `origin_required` | A publishable key with an origin allowlist was used with no Origin header, as from a server or a native app. |
| 403 | `origin_not_allowed` | The calling site is not on the origin allowlist of this publishable key. |
| 404 | `not_found` | Nothing is served at this path, or the identifier in it does not exist. A path miss adds suggestions, the closest real endpoints. |
| 405 | `method_not_allowed` | The path exists for a different HTTP method. The body lists the accepted methods in allow, as does the Allow header. |
| 409 | `conflict` | The request cannot be applied in the current state. |
| 410 | `gone` | The path was removed permanently. |
| 413 | `payload_too_large` | The request body is larger than the API accepts. A body far over the cap is refused before it reaches the API and returns a bare 413 with no JSON body. |
| 415 | `unsupported_media_type` | A request with a body was sent without Content-Type: application/json. |
| 422 | `unprocessable_entity` | Every field is valid, but the combination cannot be computed. |
| 429 | `rate_limit_exceeded` | The monthly request allowance is used up. Retry-After gives the seconds to the reset. |
| 429 | `rate_limit_per_minute` | The per-minute limit of the plan was reached. Retry-After gives the seconds to the next minute, and the monthly allowance is not charged. |
| 429 | `rate_limited` | A rate limit was reached, reported without the plan detail. |
| 429 | `free_tier_exhausted` | A keyless request has used up its trial allowance. |
| 429 | `reports_rate_limited` | Too many reports were requested this minute. Retry-After gives the seconds to the next minute. |
| 500 | `internal_error` | The request failed inside our service. Retry with exponential backoff. |
| 503 | `compute_saturated` | Heavy calculations are briefly at capacity. Send the same request again after Retry-After seconds. |
| 503 | `reports_busy` | Report rendering is briefly at capacity. Send the same request again after Retry-After seconds. |
| 503 | `report_render_timeout` | The report took too long to render. Send the same request again. |
| Any | `error` | A fallback for a status with no more specific code. The status and the error field carry the signal. |
<!-- END:ERRORS -->

Retries are on by default: `Roxy(key)` resends a request up to twice after a 429, 500, 502, 503 or 504, or a connection that was never made, waiting for `Retry-After` when present (up to `maxDelay`, default 30 seconds) and a jittered backoff otherwise. `Roxy(key, maxRetries: 0)` turns retries off. A read timeout is never retried. On a persistent failure the total is 1 + `maxRetries` requests, so 3 by default and exactly 1 with `maxRetries: 0`. A network failure (DNS, timeout, connection reset) throws the HTTP client exception instead of `RoxyException`.
